findings.issue: The competition brief, site plans and 3D model are still unopened after four rounds. I re-fetched S01 on 21 Oct 2026: 'Download brief' is '#', and the brief and site-file links have no URL. Every quantitative requirement an entrant would act on (244-305 m, 9.0 FSR non-residential and its basis, jury weights 40/30/20/10, 4 x A2, 10 MB, the below-grade transit link, site location) traces only to S78, a team-supplied text that is not independently verified. The labelling is honest, but an entrant cannot rely on any of it, and the protected-view check (A4) cannot run without site coordinates.
findings.fix: Before registration closes on 29 Oct, a registered member downloads the brief and site files (A1). Add the brief as an opened source with date and page numbers. Re-cite or correct every S78 figure. Record the street names, coordinates and true north. Then run A4 the same day. If registration is not paid, record that decision and mark the packet 'not usable by entrants'.

findings.issue: The as-is workflow is this packet's main deliverable, and every step is still a hypothesis with interview n=0. The two interviewees are unnamed. The recruit deadline is 26 Oct, five days away, and no candidate list or channel is recorded. The interview protocol (per-step hours, tools, rework, skipped work, handover breaks) exists only as one sentence, with no question script or recording template.
findings.fix: Name the two candidates, or the channel (e.g. ARCH 540 class list, SALA VTC-registered teams) and who contacts them, by 24 Oct. Attach a one-page question script and a dated answer template per step_id. If the interviews are not done by 5 Nov, state in the packet that downstream packets must not use any step's pain points for module priority.

findings.issue: Step 1 and S54 say City open data has 'no 3D massing or topography title'. On 21 Oct 2026 the City catalogue returned lidar-2022, lidar-2018, lidar-2013, digital-elevation-model, elevation-points and 1, 2 and 10 m contour datasets. LiDAR 2022 is under the Open Government Licence - Vancouver, has 181 tiles of zipped LAS, and is classified, including a 'buildings' class. This is a citable, free route to the context massing and topography that step 1 says is missing.
findings.fix: Add a source for opendata.vancouver.ca/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/lidar-2022 (modified 18 Apr 2023, OGL-Vancouver, classified LAS incl. buildings) and the DEM. Correct S54 and the step 1 input. Note that the 2022 capture predates towers completed since, so recent context still needs checking.

findings.issue: Owners are 'Student A/B (proposed; team confirms)', and nothing records that the team confirmed them. 'Instructor' is unnamed. The actions table is serialised as a JSON string inside the spec, so tools and reviewers cannot filter or validate it. Several deadlines fall within 5-8 days (A10 28 Oct, A2 28 Oct, A7 29 Oct) and have no status updates.
findings.fix: Store actions as an array of objects. Add a 'confirmed_by_team' date field. Name the instructor role holder. Update the status of each action at the next round.

findings.issue: The S75 extract says protected views are 'not addressed' in the FAQ. Re-read 21 Oct 2026, the FAQ lists 'the protection of public views and connections to the city's natural setting' as a consideration the review must balance. The 600 ft (183 m) statement applies to sites within the policy area, for example those across from the Bay Parkade. It is not a blanket cap that can be compared directly with the VTC block before the block is located.
findings.fix: Correct the S75 extract. In step 7b, say that 183 m is 'may be considered' within the current policy area, and that it applies to the VTC block only once A1 locates the block.

findings.issue: 'STL/FBX compatibility mode ends 1 Nov 2026' could not be found on the pricing page or the integrations page (re-read 21 Oct 2026). The integrations page lists STL and FBX as supported drag-and-drop formats, with no end date.
findings.fix: Cite the exact page that states the 1 Nov 2026 end date, or delete the claim.

findings.issue: 'A grant activated 19 Oct runs to about 30 Nov' implies an Infrared account was opened on 19 Oct. No source or action records that anyone registered. The arithmetic (19 Oct + 42 days = 30 Nov; 21 Oct + 42 = 2 Dec) is correct, but the premise is unsupported.
findings.fix: Either record who registered and when (as an action outcome), or reword as 'if activated on date D, tokens expire D + 42 days' and leave the date to A9.

findings.issue: Every jury_tag carries the weight in its name ('human_scale_40', 'cultural_context_30'). Those weights come only from the unverified S78, so the tags hard-code an unconfirmed number into downstream module metadata.
findings.fix: Use weight-free tags (human_scale, cultural_context, design_excellence, urban_integration). Keep the weights in one editable team-assumption table cited to S78 until the brief confirms them.

findings.issue: Step 4 and the Ladybug and Eddy3D case studies rely on an EPW weather file and wind climate data, but no source is given for either. These inputs drive every sun, wind and comfort result in CLIM modules.
findings.fix: Add a sourced weather file (e.g. the Vancouver International EPW from a named repository, with station, period and licence). Flag the downtown-vs-airport wind difference as a team assumption.

findings.issue: S43, S62, S63, S69, S70 and S72 are still opened:false after four rounds. This reviewer's web-search budget was also exhausted on 21 Oct 2026, so the second-hand figures (14 of 38 views removed, UNDRIP dates, Forma seat terms) remain unconfirmed.
findings.fix: A5, A6 and A7 must be done by a person in a browser. Record the outcome in each source's extract and switch opened to true, or drop the source.

findings.issue: 49 sources against guidance of about 40. Several are thin or only point to other sources (S28 UpCodes, S59 EC3 unread terms, S27 superseded by S52).
findings.fix: Merge S27 into S52 and S67 into S66. Drop S28 unless jurisdiction coverage is confirmed.

false_assumptions.correction: Context massing and topography can be derived from City LiDAR 2022 and the DEM. Cite them in step 1 and note the 2022 capture date.

verdict: Not passed. Round 4 fixed the r3 citation errors honestly. SimScale, S01 scoping, competition-use flags, demo attributions and an action table are all correct, and the 11 sources I spot-checked mostly match. An entrant still cannot rely on it. The brief has never been opened, so heights, FSR, jury weights, board limits and site location rest on an unverified team text. The block is not located, so the view-cone check cannot run. The as-is workflow, the packet's core, has no interviews behind it. One new factual error: City LiDAR 2022 and DEM data exist, but the spec says no 3D or topography data was found. The S75 'protected views not addressed' line is also wrong. The gate passes once A1 and A4 are done before 29 Oct and interviews are recorded.
